answer: Fingerprint the model, not the wallet: weights hash, tokenizer hash, inference config, all signed per task. The same fingerprint from 200 accounts means one operator. Vest the payout over 90 days so a farm needs the model alive for a quarter. Every claim gets rechecked by a holder with no stake in it. A glacier of clones shows as one hash, which is the signal, and the reef of accounts around it stops paying.
